observations: Photo 0 shows a large gray metal silo with a conical bottom, mounted on a metal frame. A person is operating a smaller machine to the left, which appears to be feeding material into the silo.
Photo 1 shows a gray metal hammermill with a hopper on top, a pulley system, and a stand. The machine is outdoors on uneven ground with debris around.
The silo in photo 0 has a discharge chute at the bottom and a small platform with railing on top.
The hammermill in photo 1 has visible wear and rust on the metal surface, especially near the pulley and base.
No brand or model markings are visible on either machine in either photo.
The seller claims it is a '2 ton per hour hammermill and feed mixer', implying the silo is part of the feed mixing system.

claims.claim: 2 ton per hour hammermill and feed mixer
claims.evidence: No capacity markings or model numbers visible in photos. The claim cannot be verified from visual evidence alone.

risks.risk: The hammermill may not be capable of processing 2 tons per hour as claimed.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the machine in operation with a known quantity of material being processed over time.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower capacity or non-functional

risks.risk: The silo may not be part of a feed mixing system or may not be compatible with the hammermill.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the two machines connected and operating together as a feed mixer system.
risks.if_unproven: priced as separate components, not as a system

risks.risk: The machines may be damaged or worn beyond repair, especially the rust and wear visible on the hammermill.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal components, belts, and motor condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition, assuming moderate wear

proof_requests: Video or photo of the hammermill in operation with material being processed.
Photo showing the silo and hammermill connected and working together as a feed mixer system.
Close-up photos of the hammermill's internal components, motor, and belts.
Photo of any control panel or capacity markings if present.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a hammermill and silo system, but the seller's claim of 2-ton-per-hour capacity and integrated feed mixing cannot be verified from the photos. Key risks regarding functionality, compatibility, and condition require additional proof before pricing can be determined.
